definitions.docs_per_hour: documents read / read wall clock (all workers loaded -> last document back; reloads after a crash included, first loads not)
definitions.latency_s: per document, seconds the worker spent on it (OCR + model + post-processing); the queue wait is not in it
definitions.wh_per_1000_docs: energy over the run / documents read x 1000; energy from the xpu-smi energy counter (end - start, all cards in use) when it behaves as a running counter, else mean sampled power x read wall clock (energy_source says which; sampled_* always kept); marginal_wh_per_1000_docs subtracts the idle power measured just before
definitions.memory: xpu_smi_peak_used_gb: device memory used (whole card, all processes), peak over load + run; per_worker_gb_est = (peak - idle) / workers on that card; fdinfo_*: the workers' own DRM fdinfo drm-total-vram (Linux)
definitions.scoring: pipeline.audit on the collected reads, then eval.read_accuracy and eval.run_eval.score (as bench_tiered); same_scoring_as_k1 compares key_fields_wrong, rule_f1, docs_for_person
definitions.supervisor: a worker that dies is restarted and its document retried once; a second failure on the same document sends it to a person (READ_REVIEW, reason reader_crash); no fixed reloads
